content: Nae Porona: Karaisiti Isu nkaposorogawe, Koti abogana unatantemine. Piya, Epesasi kumatasa Kotiti atokaema Karaisiti Isu nkawamu wasiye kina, ma nkisapa tigeti kaeyuwe.
Pigoya, tabarempa Koti, Wa'ega Isu Karaisiti, isigetisa awagaenabe paruyenabe tigeti waiyeno.
Koti mono ki tayakintiye
Pigoya, Wa'egare Isu Karaisiti nkabawampa Koti, aeba mantarasaena akayona puratama, Karaisititi atokaentompeka mono kao'enawa toma toma tamemine. Pika agega'eba asagayuyeno.
Paipa ma mpaba kampa puntometa aeba Karaisititi atokaeratakenaga utaratantine. Taeba ae aobi aota mima kamanate kampa waikibika Koti piyama utaratantine.
Piya, Koti aewa nkabomeka, Isu Karaisititi atokaema araga yagarawaka uma mikunompeka, agu kao'ena puratama utaratantine.
Aeba abugai ntagarawaka uma e'wasaenawa awagaenawatasa atitatama aogi puratantine. Piya pemika, Koti nkagega'eba asagayuyeno.
Piya, Koti nkawagaenawampa pumaewaogana, Isu pu'magina koratasa aibo'enarepa asu'a puragasima ika puratantine.
Piya, awagaenawapa asunu kaema uwaena tamintana, aogi napiyena abompentanarepa aboraratantine.
Piya, paipa Koti ae'wa nkabugaomentana kakamagina, pai Karaisiti ntuga aborakibemika untemintana ibaba aega'ma taeyakiye.
Pi nkabugaomentanaga ke i'ma, aborakibi ntagaga aeba ago a'itantiye. Piya, mantarasaenabe mampabisaenabe aki potama, Karaisitiba a'ya'maenama nkwa'ega mikiyema, untiye. Pi untintanaba aboraratantiye.
Pigoya, Kotiba ae'wa nkaumawatasa uma a'ya'waemaena esegi piye. Pi'na paipa tagama napimagina, Karaisitika uma ae tu mpikunompeka utaratantine.
Piya, paitama Karaisititi atokaentompe kina'miteka, Koti nke'wasaenawantaga mima agega'e asagayukenaga utaratantine.
Piya, tigeba pabiya taga kamana, ti'ikena aogi mono kamana, abima Karaisiti nkaegarantakana Koti aeba pai tamikena utaratantemi Nkaota Awamusapa tigepe taepe tamima, ae ara'ena purataye.
Pabiyama, Koti ainti tababuma utaratanti nke'wasa antota tamikibika napima, ibaba Aota Awamusa'wa tamegina, taege kaga mimagina Koti nkara'ena purataye. Pika agega'e asagayuyeno.
Epesasi kina'mika Poro nunamu untiye
Piya, tigeba Wa'ega Isuti timatiti potamagiri, a'ya'ma Kotiti atokaenta kina'miti agu kao'ena puwaitawe. Pika tiwaga kamana abimagi,
nunamu yo ntagaba asi nasi tigeka napimagi, Kotiti na'mu potauwe.
Piya, Wa'egare Isu Karaisiti ae Koti, e'wasa tabarempa, ae'wa nkauma timekiri, pika aososima napiyigina, Wa'egawama nkagowapa uma aboraritakiri, abibebe puma abiyoma, nunamu yuwe.

Piya, e'wasaenama ntapiyenawa timisanagaba nabiye. Mantabisa tigeti aborakibi'na tigeba aogima abisanagaba nabiye. Pigoyema, Koti utaratanti nke'wasa antotapa aeti atokaentompe kina taeti aborakibi'na, abigina au'wantana peno.
Piya, Isu nkaegarantompe kina'miteti esegiyenawapa aboraramima tabe puma asu againtiye. Pi nkesegi yugawaka abigina au'wantana peno.
Piya, pi nkesegiyenawatasa Karaisiti purintapisa asitamagina mantabinti ayatakanti asitantiye.
Piya, ibabe aintibe a'ya'ma kiya kinape, kabirata kinape, esegi kinape, kamana ukena kinape, a'ya'ma toma toma inta kinape, Koti otagina Karaisiti asu igasima mintiye.
Piya, Karaisiti nkagisabinti a'ya'waemaena potama, a'ya'ma monota ai'aru pompe kina'mite nkai'nere otantiye.
Piya, mono kina'mitaba Karaisiti nkaukanta puma miyokana, Karaisitiba tantabaipinti mima, a'ya'waemaenaba pumaetama miye.
